environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the function specifies a principal condition of aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-a1b2c3d4e5) and requires lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action with the FunctionUrlAuthType condition key set to AWS_IAM. Callers must present valid SigV4 signatures from IAM principals within the organization. The function URL returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request lacking a valid SigV4 Authorization header. Note: the code itself performs no authentication checks - all auth enforcement is at the Lambda Function URL invocation layer before the handler executes.

config.network: public internet accessible (but IAM auth enforced at invocation layer)
